runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Out with rest, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Held up last, keen 800m out, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on strongly to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。八百米處搶口。未能望空直至二百米處。末段以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Mid-field, tight for room 400m out, stayed on final 300m but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。四百米處空位不足。最後三百米保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Raced in touch, chased leaders from top of home straight, stuck to task but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自直路初起追趕領先馬匹。持續力拼，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail, 5-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat worse than midfield, closed off fairly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段衝刺一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W6W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W6W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊，直路上超越部分已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made some minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat towards the rear, hung out and never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列。外閃，從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast(+) (4W2W3W) Held up from wide draw, still last top of home straight when short of room briefly, stayed on between horses.
(Jockey dropped whip at 100M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速(+)(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留後。直路初仍居包尾位置，一度空位不足。在馬匹之間保持走勢。
（騎師於一百米處跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (5W1W1W) Sat rear, made the turn wide, not much ground made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(5W1W1W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時走外疊。直路上追前不多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 9 lengths or so back turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 起步時被碰撞，失去平衡，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約九個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start and unbalanced, raced better than midfield but trapped wide early, 2 wide after entering the back straight, 2 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，失去平衡。居中間之前位置，但早段走外疊。進入對面直路後走第二疊。入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted across to the tail of the field from gate 13, swung wide for a run at the home straight, rushed home despite laying in.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，切入居尾列。直路上向外移出取位。儘管內閃，但末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Held up in last pair from wide draw, still in rear entering home straight, hung right, little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居最後兩位之內。入直路時仍居後列。內閃，無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat midfield 3 wide, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) In last few after beginning from the widest barrier, jockey reported lost use of iron briefly, improved steadily in back straight to reach midfield 4-wide onto home bend, even wider turning in for home, soon weakened on straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 自大外檔出閘後居最後數位之內。騎師報告，他的左腳曾脫出腳踏。對面直路上穩步上前，開始轉直路彎時進佔中間位置，走第四疊。入直路時走更外疊，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W4W) Towards rear, taken wide bend, hung right under pressure, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W4W) 居後列。直路彎移出外疊。在催策下內閃，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Ridden along from widest draw to lead, joined 700m out, under pressure to hold position 400m out, gave ground quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策，領放。七百米處被追及。四百米處受催策以保持位置。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Jumped only fairly, trapped 4 wide, slightly better than midfield, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍前位置，走第四疊。直路早段對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped on terms, settled just off the pace, had every chance from 400M, run ended mid-straight and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居領放馬稍後的位置。自四百米處起一度甚具爭勝機會。直路中段無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Crowded on jumping, sat towards rear, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 躍出時受擠迫，居後列。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Raced very wide throughout, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 沿途走大外疊。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, moved a little bit closer on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace three wide, keen early, quickly lost place turning into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊，早段搶口。入直路時迅速失位，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Stumbled leaving stalls, raced three wide in rear, keen early, briefly hampered 600m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘時失蹄，居後列，走第三疊。早段搶口。六百米處一度受阻礙。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out approaching 500M, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off very strongly to score. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。趨近五百米處時向外移出。入直路時落後三個馬位，末段衝刺凌厲，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Raced very wide throughout, lost balance 900m out, dropped to last place 600m out, widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 沿途走大外疊。九百米處失去平衡。六百米處墮居包尾位置。入直路時走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Shifted out and bumped at start, three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Three wide in mid-field, taken wider on bend, under pressure 600m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎移出更外疊。六百米處受催策。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Shifted out at start, raced in midfield on the outside, there to turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W5W) Mid-field, very wide throughout, unable to pick up from 300m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W5W) 居中間位置。沿途走大外疊。自三百米處起未能加速。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, ran on strongly to lead close home and hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。其後以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid division, under pressure 600m out, switched wide for clear run 400m out, short-lived effort 200m out, unable to sustain.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。四百米處移出外疊以望空。二百米處一度發力，其後無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact, sent forward to take the early lead, headed 1100M, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，早段受催策上前，取得領先。千一米處被超越。中段落後領放馬一至兩個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, unable to pick up for pressure from 500m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策以跟隨領先馬匹。自五百米處起受催策，未能加速。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。受催策時保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, taken wider 600m out, briefly hampered 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處被帶出較外疊。四百米處一度受阻礙。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Sat handy, raced wide, one pace to the line (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 居前列，走外疊。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, ran on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Slightly slow out and made contact shortly after start, positioned a length or so back, 2 away from the stands' rail, no clear run until approaching final 150M, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘稍慢，其後不久與對手互相觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走外欄第三疊。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled worse than midfield, made steady progress under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。在鞭策下穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, traveled greenly, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。走勢稚嫩。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Made contact at start, raced in midfield, 3 wide, wider turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure to hold position 600m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策以保持位置。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in mid-field, rail position, angled out under pressure 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。二百米處在催策下向外移出，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Bounded on jumping and lost ground, in rear, still in last pair turning into home straight, left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時向上跳躍及失地，居後列。轉入直路時仍居最後兩位內。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W5W) Settled worse than midfield, angled out at the Turn, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W5W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎向外移出。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Held up last from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Fast into stride, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 展步迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Settled one back in 3rd on rail within 2L of pace, angled out for a run entering home straight and faded gradually out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居第三位，落後領放馬不足兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時向外移出取位。其後逐漸力竭，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Began well, raced prominently on the outside, a length back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat at rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W4W) Jumped with them, crowded near 1100M, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, a bit closer on turn, very wide into straight, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，接近千一米處時受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat just behind the leaders 2 wide, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 350m out, headed by winner 150m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。三百五十米處加速。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Tracked leaders out wide, travelled smoothly to 350m out, ran on well final 200m to close on leader but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。三百五十米處前走勢暢順。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近領放馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Chased leader against rail, switched to challenge leader on bend, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 追趕領放馬，走內欄。直路彎轉換跑線以挑戰領放馬。以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, same position on turn, hard ridden after passing 250M, took the lead 150M, kept on strongly to the line, won by 3 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。跑過二百五十米處後受力策。一百五十米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，以三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, joined leader top of home straight, pressed on 300m out, stayed on at the one pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追逼領放馬。直路初追上領放馬，三百米處受催策，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, unable to further quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。直路上未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight but dropped away quickly, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位，但迅速墮退。末段洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid-field towards centre of course, under pressure 400m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide towards rear, 8-1/2L back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後八個半馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Wide throughout, tracked pace, weakened quickly home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，沿途走外疊。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact at start, raced towards rear on the middle track, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時發生觸碰。居後列，在跑道中央競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Sat towards rear, traveled okay, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走勢尚可。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, waited with in rear, short of room early in home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居後列，留力候上。直路早段空位不足。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般。居中間之前位置。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to press leader, challenged leader 500m out, ran on well to lead narrowly 200m out, crossed by winner 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。五百米處挑戰領放馬。以佳勢上前，二百米處以短距離領先。五十米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 400m out, ran on well final 200m but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處跟隨頭馬上前。最後二百米走勢良佳，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (4W6W) Taken back from gate 13, raced towards rear on the outside, there to turn, made good progress in straight to make frame, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(4W6W) 自第十三檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Sluggish start and crowded leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 200m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。二百米處轉移跑線以望空，保持走勢但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Raced rear, switched out at the Turn, limited response when placed under pressure (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, not enough room early in straight, showed limited response thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段空位不足，其後對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat worse than midfield, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, driven 500m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, took the early lead, headed 1250M, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader in the middle stages, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，早段取得領先。一千二百五十米處被超越。中段落後領放馬一個半馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Sat worse than midfield 2 wide, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Crowded start, raced 3 wide with cover slightly behind midfield, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run top of home straight, challenged up rail from 300m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初須等待空位出現。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, some headway on bend, short of room early in home straight, effort 200m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路彎略為追前。直路早段空位不足。二百米處發力。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, driven along 400m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受催策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 400M, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百米處向外移出。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍，未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, dropped away quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, tight for room early in home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初受緊迫，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon prominent from wide draw, led after 500m, still led by over two lengths 200m out, gradually closed down, headed 50m out and no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即居前列位置。過了五百米處後領放。二百米處仍領先逾兩個馬位。其後逐漸被追近，五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, quickened early to lead top of home straight, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，取得領先。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Wide in prominent position early, obtained 2nd 2-wide over 1000M out, unable to quicken under pressure in home straight and kept on steadily to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列，走外疊。一千米處進佔第二位，走第二疊。直路上在催策下未能加速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, 3 wide from 900M, wider turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。自九百米處起走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure to hold position middle stages, short of room early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。中段在催策下保持位置。直路初空位不足。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, tracked leader in a steadily run race, hard driven from 300M, kept up the pressure on the winner final 200M but was always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，跟隨領放馬，賽事步速平穩。自三百米處起受力策，最後二百米持續追迫頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat at the rear, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Never better than midfield, soon faded after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 從未超越中間位置。入直路後瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made very good progress in straight to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑入亞席，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in last few from a poor draw, baulked for a run after straightening until 300M out, only passed well-beaten runners.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後居最後數位之內。入直路後受困直至三百米處。僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W5W) Sat 3 wide just off midfield, under pressure from the 600M, never a threat.
(Jockey dropped whip near 400M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。自六百米處起受催策。從未能構成威脅。
（騎師於接近四百米處時跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （騎師於接近四百米處時跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled some 3L off the pace in 5th or 6th on rail, drifted slightly further back passing the 1000M coming onto home bend, saved ground making final turn but soon weakened after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居第五或第六位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。跑過一千米處開始轉直路彎時稍微墮後。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。但入直路後瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Raced rear, never traveled, eased down entering the Straight (Unacceptable Performance, Must BT, See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 居後列。沿途走勢欠順。入直路時收慢。（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, held up top of the Straight, made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路初受困。略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, unable to slot in, raced 4 wide behind midfield early, moved a bit closer after passing 1000M, positioned 3 wide better than midfield on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，未能切入內疊，早段居中間之後位置，走第四疊。跑過一千米處後略為追近，直路彎居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Mid-field, didn't travel with much fluency, outpaced and left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走勢欠順。直路上未能跟上步速及被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W2W1W) Race prominently and wide without cover early stages after beginning from the widest gate, improved steadily to 2nd without cover entering back straight, weakened under pressure shortly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，早段居前列，在沒有遮擋下走外疊。進入對面直路時穩步上前至第二位，沒有遮擋。入直路後不久在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Settled down in midfield about 4Ls off the pace, switched wide from 700M before giving limited response in the straight. Couldn't sustain run late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬約四個馬位。自七百米處起移出外疊。直路上對催策反應有限。末段未能保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Raced keenly, ridden along to lead, gave ground and failed to respond over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 搶口，在催策下取得領先。末段墮退，對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Tracked pace, forced three wide final bend, pushed along, every chance until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎走第三疊。受推策，一度甚具爭勝機會，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide from 600M, challenged the leaders turning in, took the lead approaching 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自六百米處起走第三疊。入直路時挑戰領先馬匹。趨近二百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W2W) Shifted out shortly after start, 2nd in the early and middle stages, travelled keenly and lost position near 700M, raced slightly better than midfield on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 起步後不久向外斜跑。早段及中段居第二位，搶口。接近七百米處時失位。直路彎居中間稍前位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W3W3W) Away well, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader, peaked on turn, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W3W3W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位。直路彎未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W4W) Began well from a wide draw, unable to slot in, raced 4 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，未能切入內欄，居中間之前位置，走第四疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced in touch, three wide, made effort 300m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹，走第三疊。三百米處發力。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速及領放。保持走勢直至最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, ridden to chase leading pair 400m out, unable to stay with that pair, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下追趕領先兩駒，但未能跟上。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged up rail from 400m out, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。保持佳勢，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began well, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 200M, ran on very well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳，二百米處取得領先，保持甚佳走勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Raced in touch, sustained run to chase down leader from 200m out, led 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居啣接位置。保持走勢，自二百米處起追趕領放馬。五十米處領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back turning in, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, angled out 800M, made contact 700M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。八百米處向外移出。七百米處發生觸碰。入直路時落後約四個馬位，末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Commenced well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no daylight until final 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。未能望空直至一百五十米處。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, had difficulty obtaining clear running until 200M, could not make up ground (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。二百米處前難以望空。末段未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat on pace, weakened and faded in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居前列。直路上轉弱及力竭。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away and lost ground, raced in rear, still plenty to do top of home straight, strong run final 200m but just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢及失地，居後列。直路初仍落後甚遠。最後二百米走勢強勁，但僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Squeezed out shortly after start, in rear, headway from 300m out after forced to wait for room briefly, no threat to leaders but staying on when running out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。須一度等待空位出現，其後自三百米處起追前。末段空位不足，保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away fast to take the lead, took them along at steady pace middle stages, headed by rivals nearing 200M, no extra final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。中段以平穩步速領放。接近二百米處時被對手超越。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival from 600M, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 200M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。自六百米處起受對手挑戰，直路早段保持佳勢，二百米處未能再增速及被超越，接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Shifted in at start, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began smartly from gate 13, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked on run 300M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, headed over 300m out, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。在領放下受追迫。三百米處被超越。瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide better than midfield, wider turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走更外疊。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, made minor progress. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Ridden along in last few on rail after moderate start, baulked behind runners from the 800M and forced to check 700M out, fought on steadily from one of the widest into straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，受催策，居最後數位內，走內欄。自八百米處起在馬匹之後受困，七百米處被迫勒避。入直路時為走最外疊馬匹之一，持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Ridden to midfield some 5L back in 6th about 1100M out, slightly worse rounding home bend, kept on same pace without quickening under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 受催策，居中間位置。約千一米處居第六位，落後約五個馬位。轉直路彎時略為墮後。直路上受催策，但未能加速，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Bumped shortly after the start, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 500M, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat on pace, weakened quickly inside 200M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。二百米處迅速轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at tail. Hard ridden after passing 400M, made good progress in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。跑過四百米處後受力策。直路上追前頗多，跑獲殿軍。未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, headway 300m out, stayed on well final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。三百米處追前。最後一百米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, dropped to last pair into home straight, strong run between horses from 300m out, edged ahead close home, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時墮居最後兩位之內。自三百米處起在馬匹之間衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, angled out 400M, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路早段略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Made running, raced keenly, drew away early stages, headed by winner 600m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑，搶口。早段帶離對手。六百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W3W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, angled out approaching 700M, 4 wide turning in, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W3W3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。趨近七百米處時向外移出。入直路時走第四疊。末段衝刺良佳，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W) Sat behind mid, traveled nicely, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走勢良佳。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped exiting stalls, driven along and outpaced early stages, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W4W5W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the outside, made contact near 700M, peaked turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W4W5W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊。接近七百米處時發生觸碰。入直路時未能再增速，直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W7W) Did not show sufficient pace early stages to hold a more forward position as intended, made a wide move from the rear at middle of the turn before closing off fairly in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W7W) 早段未能展現足夠前速以佔取如賽前部署般較為靠前的位置。直路彎中段沿外疊自後列發力上前，其後在直路上衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Well there from a poor draw, came to share the pace rounding home bend gaining slender lead upon straightening, led until finding no extra 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，居好位。轉直路彎時上前並排領先。入直路時領先些微距離。領先直至一百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead until 1200M, weakened inside 200M, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放至千二米處。最後二百米轉弱。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W5W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 200m but lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 1100M, 3 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, made no impression in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。跑過千一米處後略為追近，直路彎落後三個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Waited with towards rear, under pressure 700m out, switched widest in home straight, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。七百米處受催策。直路上移至最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, under pressure from 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起受催策。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled towards rear, made some ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (3W5W) Out in line, raced behind midfield on outer, 4 lengths back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened and eased final 300M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初對催策毫無反應。最後三百米轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 300M, failed to make any progress thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。跑過三百米處後望空，其後毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Bumped and lost balance out of stalls, tracked leaders against rail, switched for clear run 500m out, dropped away quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘時被碰撞及失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。末段迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside early, moved closer after passing 1250M, positioned 3 wide, a length or so back in the middle stages, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，早段居中間位置，走外疊。跑過一千二百五十米處後追近。中段落後約一個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, short of room early in home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初空位不足。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced prominently, three wide, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced prominently, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well from gate 13, took the lead, led by a 1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自最第十三檔出閘迅速，取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, dropped to midfield on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎墮居中間位置。直路初未能再增速，最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced better than midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 1100M, 2nd in the middle stages, outpaced early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過千一米處後略為追近。中段居第二位。直路早段被拋離。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, 4-1/2L back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, three wide without cover, hung in final 200m, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘，墮後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米內閃。保持走勢，但未能加速以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Raced wide towards rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能增速以展開挑戰。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Crowded and bumped out of stalls, ridden along from stalls to press leader, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘時受擠迫，發生碰撞，其後受催策，追逼領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) Began well from the widest draw, raced slightly better than midfield on outer early, moved closer after passing 1000M, 2nd in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，早段居中間稍前位置，走外疊。跑過一千米處後追近，中段居第二位。直路初未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W1W) Away with them, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, took the lead 1100M, found rail after passing 900M, led by a length on turn, peaked and headed 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。千一米處取得領先。跑過九百米處後移入內欄。直路彎領先一個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began only fairly, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared 150M but made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路初未能望空。一百五十米處望空，但其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居領放馬之後，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled nicely, switched out entering the Straight, closed off well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走勢良佳。入直路時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Just behind midfield early stages, gained closer to within 3L of pace in 6th rounding home bend, baulked for a run on rail the length of home straight, virtually not tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 早段居中間稍後位置。轉直路彎時追近至第六位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。直路上沿欄受困。從未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, good headway early in home straight, ran on strongly and beaten only narrowly,
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置，以佳勢追前。末段走勢強勁，僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, there to turn, finished off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Soon taken well back, over 7L off the pace rounding home bend, commenced move upon straightening running on steadily to reach distant 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。轉直路彎時落後領放馬逾七個馬位。入直路時開始上前。穩步上前，末段進佔落後頗遠的第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped on terms, given a waiting ride towards the rear, ran on mildly from 400M and wasn't beaten far by the placegetters.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起保持普通走勢，負於亞軍及季軍馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled last on the rail, held up in the Straight, stayed on okay once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置，走內欄。直路上受困。望空後即保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Bumped on the hindquarters at the start, positioned 5 lengths behind the leader on the inside, same margin back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 起步時被碰撞後驅，落後領放馬五個馬位，走內疊。入直路時落後相同距離。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Jumped on terms, settled in midfield but never too far behind leaders, switched into clear passing 200M before giving a strong kick to get up just in time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，但從未遠離領先馬匹。跑過二百米處時轉換跑線以望空，其後以勁勢加速，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Inconvenienced at start from the widest barrier before gradually taken back for cover, obtained cover 2-wide in 9th onto first turn dropping to last into straight, produced good late impression under pressure final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔起步時受妨礙，其後逐漸留後以取得遮擋。開始轉直路彎時居第九位，走第二疊，有遮擋。入直路時墮居包尾位置。最後二百米在催策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘時發生碰撞，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W) Slowly away, held up last, pushed along 500m out, still plenty to do top of home straight, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。五百米處受推策。直路初仍落後頗遠。最後二百米以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Crowded at start, tracked leaders, travelled smoothly to chase leaders top of home straight, strong run to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步時受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。走勢暢順，直路初追趕領先馬匹。走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) With leaders early stages, taken one back to joint 3rd some 2L off the pace in back straight, slightly further away in 4th rounding home bend, ran on under pressure to hit the front 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段跟隨領先馬匹。對面直路上留後一個馬位，並列第三位，落後領放馬約兩個馬位。轉直路彎時略為墮退至第四位。在催策下上前，一百米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Bumped on jumping, held up behind midfield 4-5Ls off the pace, responded only fairly from 400M and failed to see out the 1600m trip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，留居中間之後位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。自四百米處起對催策反應僅屬一般。未能應付千六米途程。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Not hurried early stages, given a waiting ride towards the rear but failed to run on under top weight. Never in the picture. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段未受催策，居後列，留力候上，但在負頂磅下未能追前。從未有力一爭。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 550m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Blundered shortly after start, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead near 950M, challenged by rival turning in, headed early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久失蹄，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百五十米處時取得領先。轉入直路時受對手挑戰。直路初被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in 3rd, some 4L off the fast pace rounding home bend, kept on at the same pace early in straight but swamped for a placing inside final 80M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居第三位。轉直路彎時落後步速甚快的領放馬約四個馬位。直路早段保持同速，但最後八十米被後上馬匹超越，失去一席位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield but trapped wide, sent forward after passing 1000M, 2nd in the middle stages, kept on well early in straight, peaked 250M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，但走外疊。跑過一千米處後在催策下上前。中段居第二位。直路早段保持佳勢。二百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W2W) From wide draw sent forward to chase leader, quickened up nicely early straight to take the lead near 200M, continued on well late stages and held on from the fast finishing runner-up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前追趕領放馬。直路初以佳勢加速。接近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，力拒衝刺強勁的亞軍馬匹險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along early to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) Bumped by rival on jumping, reserved in midfield before quickening up from 400M. Put in a sustained effort to lead inside 100M winning comfortably in the end.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)躍出時被對手碰撞，留居中間位置。自四百米處起加速。持續上前，一百米處取得領先，最終輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) Began fairly, recovered to midfield 700M out, ran on well in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘一般。恢復走勢，七百米處進佔中間位置。直路上以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, forced to steady on heels 800m out, wide into home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。八百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。入直路時走外疊。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Checked shortly after start, well behind until gaining closer from the 500M along the rail, quickened to reach within 2L of pace on straightening but baulked for a run inside final 200M until the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久勒避。遙居於後，直至自五百米處起沿欄追近。入直路時加速，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，但最後二百米受困直至一百米處。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Waited with in rear, good headway from halfway, chased leader final 150m, unable to quite peg back that rival.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居後列，留力候上。自半程起追前甚多。最後一百五十米追趕領放馬，但未能超越該駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly, settled back in the field, badly held up for clear running from 500-150M before closing off strongly to take 2nd beaten 3L by the runaway winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，居後列。自五百米處起嚴重受困而未能望空直至一百五十米處。其後衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，負於遙遙領先的頭馬三個馬位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W) Settled rear, switched out rounding the turn, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Ridden forward to within 2L of pace 2-wide in 4th, travelled keenly on heels of leaders from between the 1100M and 900M, drifted slightly backward to 5th approaching final turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 受催策上前，居第四位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。千一米處至九百米處之間緊隨領先馬匹，搶口。趨近直路彎時略為墮居第五位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。末段保持穩勢，但未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast into stride, took the early lead, headed near 950M, 2nd on turn, retook the lead early in straight, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段取得領先。接近九百五十米處時被超越。直路彎居第二位。直路初再度取得領先。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled about 6L off the pace in joint 4th 2-wide, in similar position into straight, fought on steadily without threatening .
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 並列第四位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時居相若位置。末段持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Settled handy, weakened passing 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居前列。跑過二百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) From draw 1 obtained a midfield position along the inside, ran on steadily on straightening to finish 4th but was always held by leaders over final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時穩步上前，取得第四名，但最後二百米一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Pressed forward to be racing just off the leader, ran on well under pressure from 400M, briefly led inside 200M but not finishing as well as the first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;受催策上前跟隨領放馬。自四百米處起受催策以佳勢上前，最後二百米一度領先，但末段衝刺不及前兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, had to wait for run turning into home straight, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled within striking distance in 3rd on rail, tight for a run early in straight, gained upper hand 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居第三位，落後領放馬不遠，走內欄。直路早段緊迫競跑。一百米處佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, driven 300m out, headed by winner 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。三百米處受催策。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Made contact at start, sent forward to race prominently, travelled well to turn, took the lead 300M, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 100M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，受催策上前，居前列。直路彎前走勢良佳。三百米處取得領先。二百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後一百米轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) From wide draw taken across behind horses, held up near last 8Ls off the pace, picked up well early straight but run ended 150M from home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後在馬群之後切入，留居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬八個馬位。直路早段加速良佳，但一百五十米處無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W) Sat midfield, traveled comfortably, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield, couldn't go on passing 300M, weakened. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百米處時無以為繼，轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped at the start, from a middle draw crossed towards the stand's side tracking leader, within striking distance always, responded well final 300M only to be out-finished by winner late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自中檔起步時發生碰撞，切向外欄，跟隨領放馬，一直落後不遠。最後三百米對催策反應良佳，末段僅不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, 2 lengths or so back, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled just better than midfield in 4th or 5th on rail, came to challenge under pressure on straightening but could only make modest headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間稍前的第四或第五位，走內欄。入直路時在催策下展開挑戰，但僅能略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Amongst leaders 3-wide, obtained outright lead on rail about 900M out setting a smart pace, led the field until joined 200M out, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 居領先馬群中，走第三疊。約九百米處以甚快步速單騎領放，走內欄。保持領先，直至二百米處被追上，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear along the inside, 5Ls to make up 400M but couldn't muster the pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。四百米處落後五個馬位，但未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W5W) Out in line, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, commenced move approaching 400M, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。趨近四百米處時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled handy on the rail, checked near 350M, not much impression made. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居前列，走內欄。接近三百五十米處時勒避。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) From draw 1 stayed close enough behind leaders, held up for clear running 400M to 200M but the finishing response was only mild over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空，末段對催策反應僅屬普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, weakened under pressure in the Straight.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路上在催策下轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Held up just worse than midfield, snuck closer in slackened tempo home bend, did not find much room under pressure early in straight, fought on steadily to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 留居中間稍後位置。直路彎賽事步速減慢時追近。直路初受催策時空位不足。持續力拼至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Waited with towards rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled towards the rear, failed to respond from home turn and soon out of contention. Finished tailed out. (Jockey - failed to travel at any stage of the event / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列。自直路彎起對催策毫無反應，瞬即再無爭勝機會。包尾大敗而回。（騎師表示，坐騎全程走勢欠佳。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) From wide draw taken back to last, over 10Ls off the pace in middle stages, got left behind turning home. Soundly beaten. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。中段落後領放馬逾十個馬位。轉入直路時被拋離。大敗而回。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden to hold position from 500m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。自五百米處起受催策以保持位置。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, struggled to hold position final bend, eased when detached 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎難以保持位置。一百米處被拋離時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎難以保持位置。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Chased the leader one-off, weakened quickly near the 250M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走第二疊。接近二百五十米處時迅速轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Awkward start, rail position in mid-field, unable to hold position on bend, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎未能保持位置，潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) Led or disputed lead early stages, gradually settled about 3L off the pace 2-wide in 2nd in back straight, became 2L 3rd around home bend, folded up quickly upon straightening.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 早段領先或爭奪領先。對面直路上逐漸居第二位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走第二疊。轉直路彎時居第三位，落後兩個馬位。入直路時迅速力竭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, disputed led on bend, headed by winner 550m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路彎爭奪領先。五百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure to hold position from 800m out, dropped away quickly in home straight, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。自八百米處起受催策以保持位置。直路上迅速墮退，洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, short of room top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初空位不足。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sluggish start, dropped in from wide draw, travelling okay top of home straight but still in rear, pushed along, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔起步緩慢，移入內疊。直路初走勢尚可，但仍居後列。末段受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace, wide throughout, weakened final 400m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬。沿途走外疊。最後四百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began well from a wide draw, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊，大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, across to track leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, moved smoothly into contention 300m out, strong run to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，切入以跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。三百米處順勢上前挑戰。走勢強勁，過終點時僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Keen early, tracked leading pair, challenged from 200m out, upsides winner and every chance 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 早段搶口，跟隨領先兩駒。自二百米處起展開挑戰。一百米處追上頭馬，一度甚具爭勝機會，但其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Settled midfield, raced wide, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat near the rear on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Raced ahead of midfield and settled more forward than anticipated, ran home one paced final 400M posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，較賽前預期為前。最後四百米衝刺時保持同速，對領先馬匹無甚威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slow to begin, sat last, stayed on well late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居包尾位置。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Not hurried early stages, given a waiting ride towards the rear 3-wide , ran past beaten rivals in the straight for a midfield finish. (Jockey - raced greenly throughout.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 早段未受催策，居後列，留力候上，走第三疊。直路上超越數匹已洩氣的對手，居中間位置過終點。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢稚嫩。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Wide in mid-field, lost position entering home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時失位。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W4W) From draw 11 positioned close to the pace but caught wide no cover throughout, kept on soundly in the straight to finish a respectable 3rd despite the tough journey.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W4W) 自第十一檔出閘，緊隨領放馬，但沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。儘管際遇欠佳，但直路上仍保持不俗走勢，取得季軍，表現可嘉。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Settled in 4th about 2L off the pace, commenced move between runners entering home straight but unable to quicken under pressure throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居第四位，落後領放馬約兩個馬位。入直路時在馬匹之間開始發力，但沿途在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, headway onto heels of leaders bend, one paced under pressure from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎上前緊隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Settled in midfield near the rail, saved ground turning in for home, improved under pressure to reach distant 2nd over 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，靠近內欄競跑。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程，在催策下上前，一百五十米處進佔第二位，落後頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, ran on strongly for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。走勢強勁，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W5W) Began awkwardly, raced keenly in a position towards the rear, swung wide for home before closing off the race mildly. (Jockey - may not have run out a strong 1400M.)
(Blood in trachea and respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，搶口。入直路時移出外疊，其後衝刺普通。（騎師表示，坐騎或未能在千四米途程上交出好表現。）
（氣管有血及有呼吸毛病。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 3 wide with cover, 3 lengths back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，落後三個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Jumped awkwardly, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the middle track, hard ridden from 300M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘笨拙，落後領放馬一個半馬位，在跑道中央競跑。自三百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Away well, raced prominently, 2 away from the stands' rail, hard ridden from 350M but only showed limited response, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，居前列，走外欄第三疊。自三百五十米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead 2 wide, weakened final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走第二疊。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled in midfield, baulked for a run early in straight and checked 250M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路早段受困。二百五十米處勒避，其後從未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat just behind the leader, hit the front at the 200M, kept on until weakened slightly final stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬稍後位置。二百米處取得領先。保持走勢，直至最後一步稍為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Ridden along from the inside barrier to lead, stuck on to feature into the top 3.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，在催策下領放。持續力拼，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped leaving stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, taken wider into home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時移出較外疊。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W) Raced prominently, unable to stay with winner 300m out, no extra final 150m and lost two places.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W) 居前列。三百米處未能跟上頭馬。最後一百五十米再無餘力，失去兩位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Mid-field, ridden along 400m out, stayed on final 200m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置。四百米處受催策。最後二百米保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, no clear run early in straight, cleared approaching 100M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，被碰撞，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路初未能望空。趨近一百米處時望空。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) From the widest draw switched off and sat 3 deep with cover at the rear, switched wide for home, made up decent late ground (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 自最外檔出閘，收慢留居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時移出外疊。末段追前頗多。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Keen under restraint in mid-field, short-lived headway over 200m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在受約束下搶口，居中間位置。二百米處一度追前。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, raced keenly, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。搶口。末段對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, picked off some weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W4W) Began well from a poor draw, gradually shifted backward to worse than midfield, commenced move on top of home bend over 500M out, ran on from 3L back into straight to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，逐漸留後至中間之後位置。直路彎早段五百米處開始上前。入直路時落後三個馬位，其後追前，最後數步獲得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well but soon taken over 2L back to 5th, fought on steadily along the rail but without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即留後逾兩個馬位，居第五位。沿欄以穩勢力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Tracked leader, hard ridden top of home straight, maintained position until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初受力策。保持位置，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Awkward start, chased leader, dropped away quickly from 500m out, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬。自五百米處起迅速墮退，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Fast into stride from draw 1 to take the lead, pressed by rival early and middle stages, struggled to keep up passing 300M, faded towards the finish. (Jockey - unsuited by being pressured in the lead.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，取得領先。早段及中段被對手追迫。跑過三百米處時掙扎上前。接近終點時轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在領放下被追迫不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled handy, traveled fairly, slightly weakened over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。走勢一般，末段略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W) Sent to forward to lead, kept on nicely without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W) 受催策上前，取得領先。保持佳勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W3W) Tracked pace, pushed along turning into home straight, weakened gradually.
(Sustained an abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained an abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。轉入直路時受推策。末段逐漸轉弱。
（左前腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat handy, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居前列。走勢不俗。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。未能望空直至三百米處。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, gave ground final 200M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。最後二百米墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield, 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W) Shifted out at start and made heavy contact, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相大力觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路初對催策反應平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Dropped back from a wide draw, at the rear early stages before moving closer to midfield making the turn for room, closed off moderately final 300M without troubling leaders. (Held up near 100M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留後。早段居後列，轉直路彎時追近至中間位置以取位。最後三百米衝刺普通，未能威脅領先馬匹。（接近一百米處時受困。）
