runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Moderately away from gate 9, raced 3 wide behind midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 自第九檔出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Ridden early before gradually dropping to midfield or slightly worse 3-wide, made no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 早段受催策，其後逐漸墮居中間或中間稍後位置，走第三疊。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Held up, well held from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 留後。自直路初起落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled towards rear on rail after sluggish start, baulked behind runners between the 500 and 250M, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內欄。五百米處至二百五十米處之間在馬群之後受困。其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress until no clear run final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，直至最後五十米未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened gradually final 100M, finished 2nd.
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個半馬位。二百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後一百米逐漸轉弱，跑獲亞軍。
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Shifted in at start and made contact, sent forward to take the lead, kicked clear after passing 300M, ran on strongly to the line, easily scored, impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時向內斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，受催策上前領放。跑過三百米處後加速帶離對手。末段走勢強勁。從容勝出，贏得漂亮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W3W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W3W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, some headway 800m out, pushed along widest into home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W3W4W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。八百米處略為追前。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) In rear after slowly away, still in rear top of home straight, good headway early in home straight, no further impression final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後居後列。直路初仍居後列。直路早段追前甚多。最後二百米再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, taken back to race at rear, 13 lengths back in the middle stages, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列。中段落後十三個馬位。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Waited with in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, switched inside to challenge up rail from 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時須等待空位出現。向內移入，自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W) Settled midfield on the rail, held up early part of the Straight, closed off strongly once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路早段受困，望空後隨即以勁勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Heavily bumped and lost balance shortly after start, mid division against far rail, good headway halfway out, ran on strongly to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久被大力碰撞，失去平衡，居中間位置，走外欄。半程時以佳勢上前。走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders towards centre of course, ridden along 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, crowded and lost balance 600m out, checked 350m out, unable to recover, eased once well held.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。六百米處受擠迫及失去平衡。三百五十米處勒避，未能恢復走勢，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, rail position throughout, unable to quicken 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。沿途走內欄。四百米處未能加速。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Crowded at start, waited with in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W5W) Jumped awkwardly, in midfield early stages before dropping back towards the rear, brought wide into straight but the finishing response was just fair.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W5W) 出閘笨拙。早段居中間位置，其後墮居後列。入直路時移出外疊，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Crowded shortly after start settling just behind midfield in 8th, baulked for a run early in home straight, produced good late impression inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後的第八位。直路早段受困。最後一百米追前頗多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) From draw 11 obtained a position behind midfield, 6Ls off leader home turn, responded fairly when brought wide to challenge on straightening. Never a serious threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 自第十一檔出閘，居中間之後位置。直路彎落後領放馬六個馬位。入直路時移出外疊以展開挑戰，對催策反應一般。從未能構成真正威脅。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Zousain from Magic Amelia, a daughter of Not A Single Doubt. Horses by the same sire include Salon S and Papaya Brose. He was given four trials for a placing in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second under slight pressure, beaten by a neck, over 800m on turf in Conghua on June 8. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished seventh under pressure, beaten by 3-3/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 18. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「蘇醒」(Zousain)之後，在港同父馬包括「極上紗瓏」及「禾道豐」等駒，生母出自「勇無疑」(Not A Single Doubt)。抵港後四次試閘一次上名。6月8日出試從化草地800米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。最近9月18日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第七名，落後頭馬3.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; Bumped out of stalls, challenged and every chance from 400m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;出閘時與對手互相碰撞。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Tassort from Cambage, a daughter of Haradasun. Horses by the same sire include Live Wire and Comet Radiance. He was given six trials for one win in Hong Kong. He made all to win by 1-1/2Ls under slight pressure over 800m on turf in Conghua on April 13. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished eighth under pressure, beaten by 21-3/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on September 15. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: Tassort之後，在港同父馬包括「烈焰光芒」及「燊輝之星」等駒，生母出自「慶能得勝」(Haradasun)。抵港後六次試閘得一勝。4月13日出試從化草地800米，早段領放，末段稍騎下以1.5個馬位之先勝出。最近9月15日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第八名，落後頭馬21.75個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Super Seth from Believe You Me, a daughter of Thorn Park. Horses by the same sire include Patch Of Cosmo and Team Team Folks. He was give three trials for a placing in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished second under a hold, beaten by 4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 21. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: 「超凡高手」(Super Seth)之後，在港同父馬包括「錶之宇宙」及「天天友福」等駒，生母出自Thorn Park。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。最近9月21日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段按韁下跑第二名，落後頭馬四個馬位。初出有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well, sat right behind the leader on the inside, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Shifted out at start, raced prominently on the stands' side, hard ridden approaching 300M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;起步時向外斜跑，居前列，靠近外欄競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began well, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, commenced move after passing 400M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走外欄第三疊。跑過四百米處後開始上前。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, weakened and gave ground in the Straight. (Unacceptable performance)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱及墮退。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped start, raced better than midfield, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked 300M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，走外欄第三疊。三百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well from gate 10, tracked leaders on the outside. Kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，跟隨領先馬匹。直路早段保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速及被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Caught 4 wide near midfield, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第四疊。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Led, weakened from the 150M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 領放。自一百五十米處起轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made running, headed 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;帶頭。一百五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Driven along from stalls to lead 700m out, kicked 300m out, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘後受催策。七百米處取得領先。三百米處加速。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) Shuffled back after slowly away, outpaced middle stages, ran on strongly but hung out final 300m to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)出閘緩慢，其後居後列。中段未能跟上步速。最後三百米以勁勢追近頭馬，但外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat on pace on the rail, weakened and gave ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居前列，走內欄。末段轉弱及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped shortly after start, settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure 500m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quicken in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Jumped only fairly, raced slightly behind midfield on the stands' side, inconvenienced near 650M, 3 to 4 lengths back at 400M, kept on one-paced to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，靠近外欄競跑。接近六百五十米處時受妨礙。四百米處落後三至四個馬位。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat behind midfield, traveled greenly, minor ground made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置。走勢稚嫩。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat rear, held up between the 200M to 150M, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列。二百米處至一百五十米處之間受困。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Sat off midfield 3 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield, held up until the 200M, closed off okay. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置。受困直至二百米處。末段衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind the lead on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, weakened at the top of the Straight, closed off only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列。直路初轉弱。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide near midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W1W) Took up running just before the 1000M bend, obtained rails run over 800M out, led until headed after straightening, folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W1W) 就在一千米處彎位前取得領先。八百米處移入內欄。保持領先，直至入直路後被超越，迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Pressed in front, unable to hold position by halfway and dropped away quickly, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;在領放下受追迫。半程前未能保持位置。其後迅速墮退。二百米處被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, headed 200m out, weakened, eased final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。轉弱，最後五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後一百五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Not the quickest out, sat worse than midfield on the rail, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘並非最快，居中間之後位置，走內欄。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W4W) Reserved in midfield 6Ls off the steady pace, switched to 3-wide making the turn for home, quickened up impressively from 400M, led mid-straight before powering away to win by big margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W4W) 留居中間位置，落後步速平穩的領放馬六個馬位。轉直路彎時移至第三疊。自四百米處起加速凌厲。直路中段取得領先。其後帶離對手，大勝而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, stayed on well, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。保持佳勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in last few, obtained a clear run 300M out, ran on well inside final 200M past beaten runners closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居最後數位之內。三百米處望空。最後二百米以佳勢上前。末段超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, switched out at the Turn, made steady progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。直路彎向外移出。在催策下以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Sat towards rear, directed out in the Straight, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居後列。直路上向外移出。末段穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Out with rest, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, peaked 450M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。四百五十米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped fairly and then shortly after was checked, ended up racing near last, had some work to do top of the straight but couldn't quite finish off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，其後不久勒避，居接近包尾位置。直路初落後頗遠，但衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden to hold position middle stages, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。中段在催策下保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W2W) Raced wide, forward move to go upsides leader 700m out, ridden to lead outright 400m out, kept going to repel challengers final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W2W) 走外疊。七百米處上前追迫領放馬。受催策，四百米處單騎領放。最後二百米保持走勢，力拒對手挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, under pressure from the 800M, took some time to respond, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自八百米處起受催策，需時對催策作出反應。末段保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W5W) From draw 12 crossed to a 3-wide spot in midfield without cover, travelled well leaving home turn and went for the lead, briefly in front near 100M before losing out in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W5W) 自第十二檔出閘後切入，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑離直路彎時走勢良佳，上前爭奪領先。接近一百米處時一度領先，其後在與頭馬幾乎齊過終點下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W2W3W2W) Settled in front of midfield, raced keenly in the early stages, commenced to improve rounding the Turn, closed off strongly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W3W2W) 居中間之前位置。早段搶口。轉直路彎時開始推進。以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Mid division, ridden along to hold position middle stages, hung in top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。中段受催策以保持位置。直路初內閃。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W5W) Slowly away, in rear, driven along final bend, held and struggling 400m out, hung right.
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W5W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。直路彎受催策。四百米處受困及掙扎上前，其後內閃。
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W4W) Sat behind mid, angled out entering the Straight, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時向外移出。走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W2W) Restrained from wide draw and dropped out in rear, still in last pair entering home straight, stayed on final 150m, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後受約束，墮居後列。入直路時仍居最後兩位之內。最後一百五十米保持走勢。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat against the fence midfield, briefly blocked for a run, stayed on ok, something further would suit.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。一度受困而未能望空。末段保持尚可走勢。增程角逐或更合發揮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W2W3W) Mid-field, forced wide and tight for room turning into home straight, again short of room 200m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時被迫走外疊，受緊迫。二百米處再度空位不足。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, held up between 300M and 200M, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處至二百米處之間受困。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled handy, gave ground quickly entering the Straight, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居前列。入直路時迅速墮退。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, effort 400m out, weakened final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處發力。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Settled ahead of midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running 300M but the finishing response was only fair after. (Trainer - Instructed jockey to take up a forward position on the Yielding track.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置。三百米處難以望空，但其後衝刺僅屬一般。（練馬師表示，他指示騎師在「黏地」狀況的跑道上讓此駒佔取前列位置。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Crowded start, raced at tail throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 起步時受擠迫。沿途居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly and ended up racing in last, under pressure 500M out and soon out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，其後居包尾位置。五百米處受催策。瞬即再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, short of room early in home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路早段空位不足。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, some headway on bend, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎略為追前。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled comfortably, switched out rounding the Turn, closed off nicely (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W2W) Held up from wide draw, pushed along 500m out, stayed on final 150m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W2W) 自外檔出閘，留後。五百米處受推策。最後一百五十米保持走勢，但未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W6W) Dropped in from wide draw, ridden to try and make ground wide on bend, stayed on late, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W6W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。直路彎在催策下嘗試推進，沿外疊追前。末段保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover behind midfield, never involved. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W6W) Away well but soon restrained to a rearward position, travelled well into home turn and made solid progress from 600M, ran home strongly final stages and just prevailed in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W6W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即受約束，居後列。進入直路彎時走勢良佳。自六百米處起追前甚多。末段衝刺強勁，在與亞軍馬匹幾乎齊過終點下僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W3W3W4W4W) Jumped only fairly, sat worse than midfield, made steady progress late (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W3W3W4W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段穩步追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Crowded at start, ridden early to take up mid-field position, wide final bend and towards rear top of home straight, finished strongly final 150m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 起步時受擠迫，早段受催策，居中間位置。直路彎走外疊。直路初居後列。最後一百五十米衝刺強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leader, ridden and outpaced 400m out, stayed on final 150m, tight for room between rivals closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受催策，被拋離。最後一百五十米保持走勢。末段在馬匹之間受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, closed off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat 3 wide behind midfield, closed off nicely, no threat to top 2.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Crowded at start settling in midfield, baulked briefly for a run over 350M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置。三百五十米處一度受困。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, not much impression made (See Incident Report).
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced behind midfield on the outside, 6-1/2L back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W4W) Jumped fairly, given a reserved ride near the rear, still 8Ls to make up 400M, closed off moderately to claim 5th but was never likely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W4W) 出閘一般，居後列，留力候上。四百米處仍落後八個馬位。衝刺普通，取得第五名，但從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, slightly improved on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為推進上前。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled handy, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
(Lame in right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居前列。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W4W) Waited with towards rear, taken wider 900m out without cover, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W4W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處被帶出較外疊，沒有遮擋。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 350m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。三百五十米處受催策。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover in front of midfield, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leader, weakened from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。自直路初起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 500M, 5 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W3W) From wide draw taken back to last, pressed along home turn and had 7Ls to make up on leader 400M, took time to get going and commenced to finish off well final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。直路彎受催策。四百米處落後領放馬七個馬位。加速需時。最後二百米開始以不俗走勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Crowded on jumping, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 躍出時受擠迫，沿途居後列，從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw settling 3-wide in last few, came under pressure to hold place rounding home bend but dropped to the last leaving the 600M, ran on past well-beaten horses closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走第三疊。轉直路彎時受催策以保持位置，但於跑離六百米處時墮居包尾位置。末段超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, 2 wide from 900M, 6 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。自九百米起走第二疊。中段落後六個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, headed over 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。三百米處被超越。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, kept on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled fairly, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢一般。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled on pace 2 wide, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Tracked pace, unable to quicken 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處未能加速。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Led, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 領先，其後直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, under pressure to hold position 700m out, bumped and lost balance 250m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。七百米處在催策下保持位置。二百五十米處與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace, three wide throughout, one paced under pressure final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，沿途走第三疊。最後三百米在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W1W1W) Made running, challenged 700m out, remained in share of lead until 400m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W1W1W) 領放。七百米處受挑戰。四百米處前仍並排領先。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Tracked leaders three wide, keen, effort over 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走第三疊，搶口。三百米處發力。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, headed approaching 700M, retook the lead 500M, kept on very well in straight and won by a length. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。趨近七百米處時被超越。五百米處再度取得領先。直路上保持甚佳走勢，以一個馬位之先掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W6W6W) Dropped out from wide draw, commenced move out wide 900m out, unable to improve position, left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W6W6W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。九百米處開始上前，走外疊。未能推進，直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Began well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, peaked 200M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。二百米處未能再增速。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace, switched out rounding the Turn, hampered at the top of the Straight, not much progress made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列。轉直路彎時向外移出。直路初受阻礙。無甚進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及與他駒互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。一百五十米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W2W) Sat worse than midfield, traveled smoothly, responded fairly well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走勢暢順。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked pace, chased leaders from top of home straight, stayed on well, gradually closing down winner final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自直路初起追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，最後一百米逐漸追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Switched off to race at the rear of the field over 10Ls back middle stages, steadied 300M when commencing to finish off the race, had to change lane but the final effort was just fair.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 留居後列。中段落後逾十個馬位。三百米處在開始衝刺之際收慢。末段須轉換跑線，但衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W2W2W) Sat worse than midfield, raced keenly in the early and middle stages, no clear run until 200M, could not be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，早段及中段搶口。未能望空直至二百米處，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat in front of midfield, traveled nicely, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走勢良佳。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, sat towards rear, traveled nicely, was crowded making the Turn, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，走勢良佳。轉直路彎時受擠迫。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W3W) Tracked leaders out wide without cover, effort to challenge winner 500m out, travelled strongly to join winner 200m out, weakened final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處發力，對頭馬展開挑戰。末段走勢強勁，二百米處追上頭馬。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, lay in in the Straight, limited response. (See Incident Report)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上內閃。末段對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Mid-field, ridden along into home straight and unable to hold position, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。入直路時受催策，未能保持位置。轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Settled wide in last few dropping to last about 900M out, made no further impression from a similar position into home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 居最後數位之內，走外疊。約九百米處墮居包尾位置。入直路時居相若位置，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Soon taken back to worse than midfield, lost cover 3-wide rounding home bend dropping to last into straight, kept on under pressure past well-beaten horses.
(Sustained a cut to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a cut to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 瞬即留居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時走第三疊，失去遮擋。入直路時墮居包尾位置。在催策下保持走勢，末段超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。
（右前腿割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped at the start, dropped back to race towards the rear 5Ls off the pace, made some inroads towards the finish but failed to seriously threaten at any stage.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時發生碰撞，墮居後列，落後領放馬五個馬位。末段略為追前，但從未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, struggled to hold position from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起難以保持位置。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Maintained a position in midfield, came under pressure home turn and dropped away on straightening. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受催策。入直路時墮退。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (6W3W3W) Began well from gate 10, trapped very wide in midfield early, moved a bit closer after passing 850M, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(6W3W3W) 自第十檔出閘迅速。早段居中間位置，走大外疊。跑過八百五十米處後略為追近。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W2W2W) Sent forward to be racing outside the lead, struggled to keep up 350M, gave ground rapidly mid-straight. (Jockey - racing wide without cover the principal reason for its disappointing run.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W2W2W) 受催策上前，居領放馬外側。三百五十米處難以跟上對手。直路中段迅速墮退。（騎師表示，坐騎在沒有遮擋下走外疊是表現令人失望的主因。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on rail, crowded near 550M, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內欄。接近五百五十米處時受擠迫，直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, wider turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W1W) Keen in mid-field, allowed to stride forward out wide and led 600m out, headed over 150m out, fading when tight for room closing stages.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居中間位置，搶口。獲許展步上前，走外疊。六百米處取得領先。一百五十米處被超越。末段受緊迫之際力竭。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled well back from a wide barrier, keen when tempo slackened approaching first bend, snuck closer to within 5L of pace on rail in 11th into straight, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後遙居於後。趨近首個彎位時在步速減慢之際搶口。入直路時沿欄追近至第十一位，落後領放馬不逾五個馬位。末段追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Broke well before settling in rear of midfield, became worse in 8th rounding home bend, ran on well under pressure near the centre of the track to claim 3rd closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時居後列第八位。末段靠近跑道中央競跑，在催策下以佳勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Settled just worse than midfield, ran on steadily inside final 250M but without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間稍後位置。最後二百五十米以穩勢追前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Close up on rail early, carried backward losing a couple of lengths onto first turn, midfield rounding home bend but snuck back up after straightening, making good ground when running into heels and checked 150M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 早段跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。開始轉首個彎位時墮後數個馬位。轉直路彎時居中間位置。入直路後再次上前，追前甚多，一百五十米處靠近對手後蹄時勒避，其後從未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M, finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位，直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Shifted out at start, raced prominently on the stands' rail, hard ridden approaching 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;起步時向外斜跑，居前列，走外欄。趨近三百米處時受力策。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) Ridden in first few early settling just over 1L off the pace in 3rd. Made little progress early in straight. Kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 早段受催策，居前列第三位，落後領放馬稍逾一個馬位。直路早段略為追前。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路初略為追前。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處轉換跑線以望空，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced prominently on the inside, 1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走內疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初未能再加速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Raced in rear, struggled to hold position final bend, pushed along widest into home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 居後列。直路彎難以保持位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持同速。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Settled towards the rear two off the outside rail, unable to quicken when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;居後列，走外欄第三疊。在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Began awkwardly and made contact, taken back to race at tail, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Waited with in rear, driven along and some headway early in home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路早段受催策，略為追前。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped at the start, from draw 10 dropped back to near last, had some work to do 400M, finished off nicely to take 5th. Nearest line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自第十檔起步時發生碰撞，墮居接近包尾位置。四百米處稍為落後。衝刺良佳，取得第五名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat midfield, traveled only fairly, gave ground quickly in the Straight (Must BT).
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。直路上迅速墮退。（必須試閘及格。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Out with rest, raced behind midfield on inner, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear, 7 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約七個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Bumped start, positioned 1 out 1 back, there to turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二疊第二位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Sat in front of midfield 3 wide with cover, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。 末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W5W) Caught 3 wide no cover near midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W5W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, keen early, ridden top of home straight, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，早段搶口。直路初受催策，掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, raced in midfield, nearer to the middle track, hard ridden from 400M but only showed limited response, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。自四百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Keen early, waited with in rear, last at halfway, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段搶口，居後列，留力候上。半程時居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, switched to challenge leaders 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線以挑戰領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, 6 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 留居後列，落後約六個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) From a wide draw taken back to near the rear, no daylight until 250M, ran on strongly just missed by a short head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。末能望空直至二百五十米處。以勁勢上前，僅以短馬頭位落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W5W) Very wide throughout from high draw, lost ground on leaders on bend, headway 200m out, flattened out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W5W) 自最外檔出閘，沿途走大外疊。直路彎落後領先馬匹。二百米處追前，洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled reasonably well, dropped back quickly in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。走勢不俗。直路上迅速墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled midfield 3 wide without cover, hard ridden at the top of the straight but found little and was one-paced to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受力策，但再無餘力，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled some 3L off the pace in 5th on rail, kept on under pressure after straightening before finding no extra closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走內欄。入直路後在催策下保持走勢。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Raced in mid-field. Going well but unable to obtain clear run from 300m out to 100m out. Stayed on once clear and finished with running left. Promising debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。走勢良佳，但自三百米處起未能望空直至一百米處。望空後保持走勢，衝刺時外閃。初出表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Away well, sent forward to race prominently, took the lead turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。入直路時取得領先。二百米處未能再增速及被超越，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well travelling one back on the rail, baulked for a run on rail until forced to switch 150M out, responded well to hit the front briefly before pipped at the post.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後一個馬位，走內欄。沿欄受困，直至一百五十米處被迫轉換跑線。末段對催策反應良佳，一度進佔領先位置，直至在終點僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Chased the leader, raced wide throughout, gave ground in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 追趕領放馬，沿途走外疊。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (3W2W) Tracked leader, carried left 300m out, unable to stay with winner final 200m but stayed on to hold second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(3W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處被帶向外跑。最後二百米未能跟上頭馬，但保持走勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began well, positioned 1-1/4L behind the leader on rail, same position on turn, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一又四分一個馬位，走內欄。直路彎居相同位置。末段以佳勢衝刺，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W4W) Sat handy 2 wide, run peaked at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W4W) 居前列，走第二疊。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先一個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Caught 3 wide no cover near midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Wide in mid-field, brief effort 400m out, soon flattened out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處一度發力，瞬即洩氣，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled well back from a poor draw, never a danger.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後遙居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) In rear after sluggish start, still in rear top of home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢後居後列。直路初仍居後列。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat near the rear on the rail, unable to quickened.
(Roarer.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 居接近包尾位置，走內欄。未能加速。
（患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Sat at the rear, closed off nicely, run peaked final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居後列。衝刺良佳。最後七十五米未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back, finished off well without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺良佳，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, keen, tight for room 300m out, no extra final 200m.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，搶口。三百米處受緊迫。最後二百米再無餘力。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (4W4W) Jumped with them, raced at rear on the outside, 8 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，落後約八個馬位，走外疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Raced in mid-division, ridden top of home straight, ran on well but no threat to winner, challenged for second but just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。走勢良佳，但未能威脅頭馬，爭奪亞軍，但僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on at the same pace in the early straight when asked, weakened in the last furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路早段在催策下保持同速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Settled midfield, raced wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began well from gate 12, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made very good progress in straight to take 2nd, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W3W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W3W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Keen and pressed leader, one of three that raced clear to halfway, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 搶口，追迫領放馬。為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。走勢暢順。以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Sat on pace, ran on fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居前列。走勢一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) From gate 10 slid forward to be one off tracking the leader, failed to sustain run and swamped in the last 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。無以為繼，最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away well, sat 1-1/2L behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, hard ridden after passing 300M, took the lead 200M, kept on very well to the line, won by 3-3/4L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。跑過三百米處後受力策。二百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，以三又四分三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on rail, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off very strongly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 自第一檔起步普通，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初未能望空。三百米處望空。末段衝刺凌厲，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Moderately away, raced prominently on the middle track, peaked 300M, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘普通，居前列，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide behind midfield, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Niggled along in forward of midfield on rail, steadied up in slackened tempo rounding home bend, baulked behind runners after straightening, quickened well inside final 150M to just get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 受催策，居中間之前位置，走內欄。轉直路彎步速減慢時收慢。入直路後在馬匹之後受困。最後一百五十米加速良佳。終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made minor ground. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Began well, restrained to race in midfield 3Ls back, couldn't accelerate enough passing halfway. Never a threat to leaders.
(Lost left front plate.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置，落後三個馬位。跑過半程時加速力不足。從未能威脅領先馬匹。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) From draw 1 always in touch behind leaders, ran on well final 300M but couldn't get near to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，一直居領先馬匹之後的啣接位置。最後三百米走勢良佳，但未能追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on outer, 6 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled behind midfield 3 wide, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked pace against inside rail, chased winner from 300m out, unable to quite match that rival but stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 沿欄跟隨領放馬。自三百米處起追趕頭馬。末段未能追上頭馬，但保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Mid-field, good headway between horses to challenge 200m out, responded well and on top final 50m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處在馬匹之間以佳勢上前展開挑戰。對催策反應良佳，最後五十米取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W) Waited with, still in rear top of home straight, stayed on final 200m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W) 留力候上。直路初仍居後列。最後二百米保持走勢，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Settled towards the rear on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Amongst leaders briefly from a wide draw and soon taken back to wide in last few, carried wider into home straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘，一度居領先馬匹之間，瞬即留後至最後數位之內，走外疊。入直路時被帶出更外疊，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well from gate 13, tracked leaders on the outside, no cover throughout, showed good response in straight, took the lead 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路上對催策反應良佳，二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Ridden early to be up with the pace, gradually shifted over 2L back in 5th home bend, angled off rail for a run on straightening but no clear run until about 200M out, quickened well late to snatch 2nd close to finish.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策以緊隨領放馬。直路彎逐漸墮居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位。入直路時移離內欄取位，但未能望空直至約二百米處。末段加速良佳。接近終點時跑獲亞軍。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, just one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。末段僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sluggish start, three wide in mid-field without cover, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, had to wait for run in first half of home straight, ran on well once gaps appeared final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。直路前半段須等待空位出現。最後一百五十米望空後隨即以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled just worse than midfield on rail, baulked for a run after straightening, obtained clear run over 150M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。入直路後受困。一百五十米處望空。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) In rear after slow start, some headway under pressure but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。在催策下略為追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) In rear after awkward start, some late headway but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Moderately away, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, showed some response early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初對催策略為交出反應。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, no extra and losing ground when becoming unbalanced 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬。五十米處在失去平衡之際再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢尚可。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Raced in touch, good headway to challenge leader 100m out, held final 50m but clear of remainder.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。以佳勢上前，一百米處挑戰領放馬。最後五十米落後，但拋離其他對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, closed off nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Soon taken back towards rear from a poor draw, travelled 3-wide around home bend and into straight, responded well inside final 300M to prevail near the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘後瞬即留居後列。轉直路彎及入直路時走第三疊。最後三百米對催策反應良佳，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W5W) Mid-field, keen mid-race, forward move 300m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W5W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。三百米處上前。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders, switched for clear run 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, weakened quickly over 300m out, eased final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。三百米處迅速轉弱。最後二百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Waited with in mid-field, pushed along when tight for room 200m out, no impression when again short of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，留力候上。二百米處受推策，但受緊迫。末段再度缺乏空位，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide off pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後競跑，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Prominent chasing leader under 7lb claimer, fought on early straight to stay in contention, lost 2nd nearing 200M, no extra final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在獲減七磅的騎師胯下居前列，追趕領放馬。直路初力拼以保持爭逐機會。接近二百米處時失去第二位。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the outside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, made contact and unbalanced near 250M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。中段搶口。直路初未能再增速。接近二百五十米處時與對手互相觸碰，失去平衡，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M but only showed limited response thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能望空。二百米處望空，但其後對催策反應僅屬平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide, weakened and gave ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊。末段轉弱及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled behind the leaders, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 6-1/2L back turning in, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六個半馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the stands' rail, passed some tired runners final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外欄。最後四百米超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Crowded shortly after the start, raced rear division of mid-field 3 wide with cover, finished off just fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Tracked leader, three wide, effort over 300m out, no extra and lost ground final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。三百米處發力上前。最後二百五十米再無餘力，墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Sluggish start, three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along 600m out, hampered and lost balance 250m out, eased off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。六百米處受推策。二百五十米處受阻礙，失去平衡。收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, some limited headway when running out of room final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。末段略為追前，最後五十米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat towards rear, held up between 400M to 300M, responded reasonably well when placed under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。四百米處至三百米處之間受困。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Shifted out, made contact and lost ground out of stalls, held up last, switched inside for clear run early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 躍出時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰及失地，留居包尾位置。直路初向內移入以望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W5W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 650M, very wide turning in, made good progress early in straight, peaked on run 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W5W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。跑過六百五十米處後向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路早段追前甚多，一百五十米處未能再增速，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Sat towards the rear, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, left behind home straight.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。直路上被拋離。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Towards rear, short-lived headway 300m out, no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。三百米處一度追前。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W5W) Trapped wide with no cover throughout from gate 11, commencing forward move from 700M, had tough run and unable to finish off (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W5W) 自第十一檔出閘。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。自七百米處起開始上前。耗力太多，末段未能以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Towards rear, good headway 300m out, no danger to winner but stayed on well to take second final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。三百米處追前甚多。最後一百米保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat worse than midfield, raced keenly in the early stages, held up at the top of the Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。早段搶口。直路初受困，末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made some headway in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden 300m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, rear of mid-field towards centre of course, effort 400m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處發力。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Behind early after slow start, in mid-division by halfway, short of room when trying to improve 350m out, stayed on once clear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，早段居後列。半程前居中間位置。三百五十米處在嘗試推進之際空位不足。最後二百米望空後隨即保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Moderately away, positioned a length behind the leader, hard ridden from 400M, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位。自四百米處起受力策。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped on jumping, raced behind midfield on the middle track, made some progress after passing 300M, peaked on run 150M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;躍出時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，在跑道中央競跑。跑過三百米處後略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W5W) Towards rear in 7th after beginning from a wide barrier about 6L off the pace, went widest turning for home, ran on well inside final 300M and did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W5W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列第七位，落後領放馬約六個馬位。轉入直路時走最外疊。最後三百米以佳勢上前。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Obtained running in midfield, picked up well on testing conditions from 400M, led passing 150M and won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。在軟地上自四百米處起加速良佳。跑過一百五十米處時取得領先，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W4W) Bumped and lost balance shortly after start, waited with towards rear, keen 900m out, strong run to lead 100m out, cozy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞及失去平衡，居後列，留力候上。九百米處搶口。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Shifted in at start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, commenced move 550M, very wide into straight, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on strongly, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處開始上前，入直路時走大外疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳，一百五十米處取得領先，保持勁勢，輕鬆掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow(-) (3W4W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on the outside, commenced move after passing 500M, finished off very strongly to be nearest on line.
(Jockey dropped right rein over the concluding stages.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Jockey dropped right rein over the concluding stages.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速(-)(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。跑過五百米處後開始上前。衝刺凌厲，過終點時最為接近。
（於末段騎師右邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Sat rear, switched out making the Turn, showed some dash inside 150M, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。一百五十米處略為加速。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W2W) Sat towards rear, badly held up entering the Straight, finished off reasonably well (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W2W) 居後列。入直路時嚴重受困。末段衝刺不俗。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W4W) Began awkwardly, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths back, same margin back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，落後四個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後相同距離。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Pressed leader, under pressure and led narrowly 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策，以短距離領先。一百五十米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) First few away from barrier 7 and sat prominent one off, exerted his authority when asked for an effort 300M out, ran straight past the leader and held the rest at bay, smart prospect.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第七檔出閘，為出閘最快數駒之一，居前列，走第二疊。三百米處在催策下控制大局，隨即超越領放馬，帶離對手至終點。前途光明。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Fast into stride, sent forward to take the lead, 2 wide, led by 1/2L turning in, hard ridden from 250M, finished off very strongly, really impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 展步迅速，受催策上前，取得領先，走第二疊。入直路時領先半個馬位。自二百五十米處起受力策。衝刺凌厲，以漂亮姿態勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W4W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, 3-1/2L back turning in, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 200M, kept on strongly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W4W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時落後三個半馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。二百米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in at start, across to press leader, quickened early to lead 550m out, kicked three lengths clear 200m out, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，切入追逼領放馬。早段加速，五百五十米處取得領先。二百米處加速帶離三個馬位。輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Box seat, well placed into home straight, pressed on 300m out, ran on strongly to lead 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。入直路時居好位。三百米處受催策。二百米處衝刺強勁，取得領先。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, commenced move 550M, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百五十米處開始發力。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, switched for clear run 500m out, quickened early to lead 250m out, headed by winner 100m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 800M, angled out 500M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。自八百米處起走第三疊。五百米處向外移出，直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Raced wide, improved to lead 1200m out, soon headed by rival top of home straight, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 走外疊。千二米處上前領放。直路初瞬即被對手超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, keen throughout, had to wait for run into home straight, bumped 350m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，沿途搶口。入直路時須等待空位出現，三百五十米處發生碰撞。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began well, raced towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Broke well from the one draw settling in forward of midfield mainly in 5th just under 6L off the pace, gained closer to just over 2L off the lead 200M out, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，大多居第五位，落後領放馬近六個馬位。其後追近，二百米處落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Last to jump, sat midfield on the rail, slightly held up early part of the Straight, ran on strongly, always held.
(Jockey dropped right rein between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Jockey dropped right rein between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘最慢，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初略為受困。以勁勢上前，但一直落後頭馬。
（騎師於二百米處至一百米處之間右邊韁繩脫手。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （騎師於二百米處至一百米處之間右邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, held up in midfield along the inside, came with a serious challenge passing 300M but was crowded 100M losing momentum. Could have finished closer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，留居中間位置，走內疊。跑過三百米處時展開真正挑戰，但一百米處受擠迫，失去步韻。本可跑入更前位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Settled towards rear, commenced move 3-wide rounding home bend, tightened and forced to switch inside 400M out, inconvenienced again just inside the 200M, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時開始上前，走第三疊。四百米處受緊迫，被迫移向內疊。跑過二百米處後再度受妨礙。末段以佳勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began only fairly, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 900M, made contact 700M, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, closed off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。跑過九百米處後略為追近。七百米處發生觸碰。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W6W) Made contact at start and unbalanced, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W6W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰及失去平衡，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Broke well from a poor draw before taken back to 5th over 4L back, further away when pace quickened around home bend, hung in inconvenienced rider over 200M out but ran on well inside final 200M, just failed to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，其後留居第五位，落後逾四個馬位。轉直路彎賽事步速加快時落後更遠。二百米處內閃以致騎師受妨礙，但最後二百米走勢良佳。終點線上僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W2W) Bumped out of stalls, across to press leader, struggled to hold position from 600m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，切入以追迫領放馬。自六百米處起難以保持位置。所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, unable to hold position early stages, angled out 500m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。早段未能保持位置。五百米處向外移出。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Stumbled leaving stalls and bumped shortly after start, in rear, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, ran on well to move into second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時失蹄，其後不久與對手互相碰撞，居後列。直路初移出外疊以望空。以佳勢追前，接近終點時進佔第二位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, settled down behind leaders along the fence, came through strongly to challenge for the lead 250M, all out final stages to beat off the persistent runner up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。以勁勢上前，二百五十米處爭奪領先。末段全力拼鬥，擊敗緊追不捨的亞軍馬匹掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From draw 1 went forward to track leader along the fence, fought well in the straight, tried had final 200M but was always held by the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬，走內欄。直路上以佳勢力拼。最後二百米力拼，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W4W) Widest throughout, dropped to rear 800m out, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W4W) 沿途走最外疊。八百米處墮居後列。入直路時在最外疊受推策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, a length back turning in, kept on well in straight without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Taken back from gate 9, raced towards rear on the outside, 5-1/4L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五又四分一個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Disputed led, led from 1000m out, under pressure 350m out, headed by runner-up 300m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 爭奪領先。自一千米處起領先。三百五十米處受催策。三百米處被亞軍馬匹超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W3W) Pressed forward from a poor draw before settling 3-wide just worse than midfield in 9th just under 8L off the pace, dropped out of contention rounding home bend from 750M out.
(Sustained a small cut to left front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small cut to left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。其後居中間稍後的第九位，落後領放馬近八個馬位，走第三疊。自七百五十米處起轉直路彎時墮退，再無爭勝機會。
（左前腿輕微割傷。）
