runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, ridden early in home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路早段受催策，在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W2W) From draw 12 pushed forward to track leader, took over nearing 350M and fought hard, shifted in under pressure 150M causing interference to rivals, lost lead inside 100M and caught by 2nd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，受推策以跟隨領放馬。接近三百五十米處時取得領先，力拼。一百五十米處在催策下向內斜跑，干擾對手。最後一百米失去領先位置，接近終點時被亞軍馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W) Bumped start, raced prominently but trapped wide early, taken back to race 2 wide slightly better than midfield after passing 1200M, 3Ls back turning in, hit the front 250M, kept on well but unable to hold off winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，早段居前列，但走外疊。跑過千二米處後留居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。二百五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰。居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position from 500m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑，發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。自五百米處起難以保持位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced wide, shuffled back mid-race, pushed along widest into home straight, did not have speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 走外疊。中段墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W4W) Prominent early settling 3-wide in midfield, gave ground quickly from 600M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 早段居前列，其後居中間位置，走第三疊。自六百米處起迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden top of home straight, strong run to lead 200m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初受催策。走勢強勁，二百米處取得領先，其後保持領先至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced slightly better than midfield, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。三百米處望空。衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, switched wide for clear run 500m out, under pressure 350m out, strong run final 200m to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。五百米處移出外疊望空。三百五十米處受催策。最後二百米衝刺強勁，終點線上僅勝。

formguide.comments_eng: Brazilian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Can The Man from Havana Club, a daughter of Vettori. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. This fellow had six starts for three wins (including a 3yo group one over 2400m) and two placings (including a 3yo group one over 2000m in Brazil and a group one over 2400m in Argentina). He was given two trials for one placing in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he was taken back and finished third under pressure, beaten by a neck, over 1200m on turf at Happy Valley on September 19. He looks a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Can The Man之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自「威多利」(Vettori)。來港前在巴西及阿根廷六戰得三冠兩亞，頭馬包括一場2400米三歲一級賽，上名賽事包括一場2000米巴西三歲一級賽，及一場2400米阿根廷一級賽。抵港後兩次試閘一次上名。最近9月19日出試谷草1200米，起步居後，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W4W) Settled at the back, quickened well inside final 200M and did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W4W) 居後列。最後二百米以佳勢加速上前，末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Raced 3-wide at the rear, unable to make up ground in the straight. (Jockey was advised he had made error of judgement by not improving position in early stages to avoid racing wide and without cover.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居後列，走第三疊。直路上未能追前。（小組告誡騎師，他於早段未有讓坐騎上前以免坐騎在沒有遮擋下走外疊屬判斷錯誤。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 250m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百五十米處向外移出以望空。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, some headway final bend, widest into home straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。入直路時走最外疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速上前展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Crowded start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled mainly in rear of midfield on rail, found no extra inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 大多居中間之後位置，走內欄。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the outside barrier, sat at the rear, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) From wide draw obtained a midfield position, 3Ls off the pace 400M, worked home evenly in the run home for 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，居中間位置。四百米處落後領放馬三個馬位。末段保持穩勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W5W) Raced behind midfield 5-6Ls back, swung wide into straight then closed off well down the outside. Went 2nd near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W5W) 居中間之後位置，落後五至六個馬位。入直路時移出外疊。其後在外疊衝刺良佳。接近終點時跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W2W) Away with them, raced in 2nd, a length or so back, challenged the leader 550M, took the lead 500M, peaked early in straight, headed 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，落後約一個馬位。五百五十米處挑戰領放馬，五百米處取得領先。直路初未能再增速，二百米處被超越，最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made running on rail and joined rounding home bend, kicked 1L clear into straight but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 領放，走內欄。轉直路彎時被追上。入直路時加速帶離一個馬位，但最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leader, driven 500m out to chase leader, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬。五百米處受催策，追趕領放馬。末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide, a length back, 3 wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run approaching 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路初略為追前。趨近一百米處時未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and bumped, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Raced prominently, outpaced by leaders final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居前列。最後二百米被領先馬匹拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, bumped over the concluding stages, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 在催策下取得領先，走勢暢順。末段與對手互相碰撞。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Checked after the start, ended up near last much further back than usual, gave only limited response on straightening. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 起步後勒避，其後居於遠較往常為後的接近包尾位置。入直路時對催策反應僅屬平平。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。轉入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced better than midfield on the inside, easy run on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 150M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時被對手碰撞，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走勢輕鬆。直路早段未能望空，一百五十米處望空，末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 躍出時發生碰撞，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。未能望空直至一百五十米處。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped on jumping, dropped back and settled near last, left behind by rivals turning in. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，墮居接近包尾位置。入直路時被對手拋離。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Chased leader on the inside after a clean start from draw 1, battled hard to stay in contention early straight, wasn't going as well as the leaders when checked 150 losing momentum.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘俐落，追趕領放馬，走內疊。直路初力拼以保持爭勝機會。一百五十米處勒避，失去步韻，走勢不及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Up with early pace before settling down 3-wide behind leaders without cover, responded well early straight to go 2nd nearing 200M but couldn't sustain run late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 早段跟上步速，其後居領先馬匹之後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路早段對催策反應良佳。接近二百米處時進佔第二位，但末段後勁不繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Box seat, travelled smoothly into home straight, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made all, keen under restraint, kicked early in home straight and ran on well, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 一放到底。在約束下搶口。直路早段加速，走勢良佳。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, obtained a midfield position along the inside, brought wide 300M to find clear running but responded only fairly. (Jockey - didn't travel well during the event and changed stride on a number of occasions.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走內疊。三百米處移出外疊以望空，但對催策反應僅屬一般。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢欠佳，數度轉腳。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 600M, 1-3/4L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後一又四分三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled comfortably, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列。走勢暢順。衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Pressed forward from a wide draw to lead about 1000M out, obtained rails run in front onto first turn and steadied up pace, headed briefly on straightening but soon re-gained advantage only to be worn down again over 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，約一千米處取得領先。開始轉首個彎位時移入內欄領放，減慢步速。入直路時一度被超越，但瞬即再度領先。僅在一百米處再度被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Broke well from the widest draw, well there and wide before taking up running about 900M out, obtained rails run onto home bend, just under 1L in front on straightening, kept on under pressure but pipped at post.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居好位，走外疊。約九百米處取得領先。開始轉直路彎時移入內欄。入直路時領先近一個馬位，在催策下保持走勢，但過終點時僅敗。

formguide.comments_eng: Brazilian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Goldikovic from Qualibet, a daughter of Burooj. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. This fellow had five starts for two wins (including a 3yo listed over 2400m) and two placings (including a 3yo+ group two over 2000m). He was given two trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he was taken back and finished sixth under pressure, beaten by 3-3/4Ls, over 1200m on turf at Happy Valley on September 19. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: Goldikovic之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自Burooj。來港前在巴西五戰得兩勝兩位，頭馬包括一場2400米三歲表列賽，上名賽事包括一場2000米三歲及以上二級賽。抵港後試閘兩次。最近9月19日出試谷草1200米，早段居後，末段力策下跑第六名，落後頭馬3.75個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, kept on well until approaching 100M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，走第二疊，落後約一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。保持佳勢直至趨近一百米處時。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，其後受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。趨近二百米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, had to wait for run on bend, short of room from 300m out to 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎須等待空位出現。自三百米處起至一百米處空位不足。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Tracked pace out wide, ridden early in home straight, bumped 350m out, stayed on steadily for a clear third but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路早段受催策。三百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。保持穩勢，在帶離餘駒下跑獲季軍，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, keen 1000m out, ridden top of home straight, crowded and briefly hampered 125m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。一千米處搶口。直路初受催策。一百二十五米處受擠迫及一度受阻礙。其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, followed runner-up through 400m out, strong run to lead 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。衝刺強勁，二百米處取得領先，帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Settled outside the lead, kept on nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, stayed on strongly, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段保持勁勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Three wide in mid-field, wide into home straight, stayed on but unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走外疊。末段保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well, taken back to race 3 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路早段未能望空。三百米處望空，末段衝刺強勁，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W5W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on outer, no cover throughout, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W5W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, still in rear top of home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Stayed in touch with leaders early stages when pace was very slow, drifted back to midfield halfway, wide on home turn, run ended mid-straight and weakened noticeably final stages. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 早段跟隨領先馬匹，步速非常緩慢。半程時墮居中間位置。直路彎走外疊。直路中段無以為繼。末段明顯轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Out with rest, settled 2 wide near the pace, showed good response early in the straight, not fully ridden out inside 100m due to rider's concern of the horse's action (See Incident Report).
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，靠近領放馬競跑，走第二疊。直路初對催策反應良佳。最後一百米因騎師對坐騎的動作有疑慮而未受全力催策。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, tight for room early in home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。直路初空位不足。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Impeded and forced to steady out of stalls, rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 500m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘時受阻，被迫收慢，沿欄居中間位置。五百米處向外移出取位。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Soon taken across from a wide barrier for an inside run, travelled tight in rear before making steady headway home bend, came to challenge under pressure upon straightening, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即切入內疊，居後列，緊迫競跑，直路彎穩步追前。入直路時在催策下上前挑戰。穩步上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out approaching 500M, finished off strongly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走第二疊。趨近五百米處時向外移出。以勁勢衝刺，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W2W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, tended to hang right in home straight, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W2W5W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。直路上傾向內閃。以勁勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear, blocked off when going for run in home straight, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路上在取位時受困，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前，跑入亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon recovered from moderate start to just over 3L back in 6th on rail, gained 5th in a similar rail position on home bend about 750M out, not much room in straight until over 300M out, quickened well to take charge at the 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，瞬即恢復走勢，居第六位，落後稍逾三個馬位，走內欄。約七百五十米處於直路彎進佔第五位，居相若位置，仍走內欄。直路上空位不足直至三百米處。以佳勢加速，一百五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Away with them, tracked leaders on the inside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed good response in straight, took the lead 50M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 與對手同步躍出，跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路上對催策反應良佳，五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, there to turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail near 700M, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, no clear run final 200M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。接近七百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初略為追前。最後二百米未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slow into stride from gate 4, ridden along early to be handy on the fence, briefly held up in the home straight, once clear picked up well to score by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第四檔出閘緩慢。早段受催策，居前列，走內欄。直路上一度受困，望空後隨即加速良佳，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) In rear after hampered leaving stalls, had to wait for run early in home straight, clear 300m out, stayed on at the one pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘時受阻礙，其後居後列。直路早段須等待空位出現。三百米處望空。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Slightly slow out settling in last few, bumped 400M out upon straightening, ran on steadily but unable to sustain effort close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘稍慢，居最後數位之內。入直路時於四百米處與對手互相碰撞。末段穩步上前，但接近終點時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W1W) Made contact at start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Showed speed to get across, keen under restraint, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現前速，切入內疊。在約束下搶口。直路初受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越，末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。走勢良佳，二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Followed leader to get across, chased leader, ridden top of home straight, faded final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬以切入，追趕領放馬。直路初受催策。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well from the 2 draw, gained outright lead passing the winning post the first time and rails run shortly after, travelled keenly from the 1100M in back straight, maintained narrow advantage around home bend, swamped.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘迅速，首次跑過終點時單騎領放，其後不久走內欄。自對面直路千一米處起搶口。轉直路彎時以短距離領先，其後被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, eased close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。直路早段加速，瞬即控制大局。接近終點時收慢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Hellbent from Jive Dancing, a daughter of Camelot. Horses by the same sire include Invincible Ibis and Lahore. This fellow had one start for one win (a 3yo maiden over 1479m). He was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished eighth under a hold, beaten by 5-3/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 18. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「不惜代價」(Hellbent)之後，在港同父馬包括「白鷺金剛」及「拉合爾」等駒，生母出自「帝皇城堡」(Camelot)。來港前在澳洲一出一捷，頭馬為一場1479米三歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘三次。最近9月18日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段按韁下跑第八名，落後頭馬5.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leaders, driven along 500m out to chase leaders, weakened quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Made contact at start, positioned 3 wide, 3 lengths or so back, no cover on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後約三個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎沒有遮擋。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W3W) Settled well back from the widest draw, made short-lived effort between the 800 and 600M, made no further impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘後遙居於後。八百米處至六百米處之間一度發力。直路上再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, bumped near 500M, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。接近五百米處時發生碰撞。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, slightly improved on turn, made contact near 350M, finished off well to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 留居後列，走第二疊。直路彎略為推進。接近三百五十米處時發生觸碰。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Away with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, raced in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled towards rear, switched out rounding the Turn, made steady ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along 500m out, challenged up rail from 200m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處受推策。自二百米處起沿內欄展開挑戰。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W) In rear after badly crowded exiting stalls, blocked off turning into home straight, unable to improve position.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時嚴重受擠迫，其後居後列。轉入直路時受困。末段未能追前。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 350M, closed off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。三百五十米處向外移出。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W) From wide draw went forward and eventually crossed to the lead before home turn, responded well under top weight mid-straight, was all out closing stages just couldn't hold off the fast finishing winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘後上前，直路彎前切入領放。直路中段在負頂磅下對催策反應良佳。末段在力拼下僅不敵衝刺凌厲的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leader 2-wide, came under pressure to challenge on straightening gaining upper hand just inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。入直路時在催策下展開挑戰。跑過一百米處後佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Raced prominently, upsides leader entering home straight, unable to stay with that rival, stuck to task, closed up final 100m but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居前列。入直路時與領放馬並跑，其後未能跟上該駒。持續力拼，最後一百米追近，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (3W2W) Well there 3-wide early obtaining 2-wide position onto home bend, gradually faded under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(3W2W) 早段居好位，走第三疊。開始轉直路彎時走第二疊。最後二百米在催策下逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked leaders, ridden along to hold position 800m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。八百米處在催策下保持位置。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W) Recovered to first few briefly after moderate start, gradually taken back from the 1000M to be over 3L back in midfield at about 700M out, made short-lived progress early in straight but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W) 起步一般，其後恢復走勢，一度進佔前列。自一千米處起逐漸留後，約七百米處居中間位置，落後逾三個馬位。直路初一度發力，但最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Slowly away, recovered to race in mid-division, checked briefly halfway, ridden along 400m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘緩慢，恢復走勢，居中間位置。半程時一度勒避。四百米處受催策，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, travelled strongly into home straight, ran on strongly to lead 100m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢強勁。以勁勢上前，一百米處取得領先。末段被亞軍馬匹追迫，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along halfway out, strong run final 200m to lead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。半程時受推策。最後二百米走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length in the middle stages, peaked and headed 250M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。中段領先一個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Bumped on jumping, driven forward chasing leaders in a 3-wide spot without cover, checked by the riderless horse at 450M, couldn't go on in the straight. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，受催策上前追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處勒避鞍上無人的馬匹。直路上無以為繼。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Across to lead from wide draw after 300m, ran on well for pressure final 200m and always holding runner-up by clear margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，跑了三百米後切入領放。最後二百米在催策下以佳勢上前，一直帶離亞軍馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Shifted out on jumping and was bumped, stayed close enough to leaders, ran on steadily final 300M but couldn't accelerate enough to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 躍出時向外斜跑及被碰撞，落後領先馬匹不遠。最後三百米保持穩勢，但加速力不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in mid-field, did not get best of runs 300m out when trying to improve, stayed on for pressure final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置。三百米處嘗試推進，但未能完全望空。最後一百米在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Soon led and set well controlled pace to the straight, quickened up nicely passing 300M before keeping on well final stages to hold pursuing rivals at bay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先。直路前以穩定步速領放。跑過三百米處時加速良佳。末段保持佳勢，力拒緊追的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, headway up rail early stages, checked 700m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。早段沿欄上前。七百米處勒避。從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Well there 3-wide, gained outright 2nd some1L back 900M out, lost position into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居好位，走第三疊。九百米處進佔第二位，落後約一個馬位。入直路時失位。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W) Soon in front setting steady pace, kept on well under pressure final 300M and gamely held on from pursuing rivals late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，以平穩步速領放。最後三百米在催策下保持佳勢。末段力拒緊追的對手掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Became unbalanced at the start, ended up 6Ls back towards the rear of the main group, made good progress in the straight finishing off final 200M fastest. (Jockey reprimanded for failing to ride out to the end of the race.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 起步時失去平衡，居主馬群後列，落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，最後二百米衝刺最快。（騎師因未有力策坐騎至終點而被譴責。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W2W2W) Chased leader, ridden to lead 200m out, soon asserted and ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W2W2W) 追趕領放馬。受催策，二百米處取得領先，瞬即控制大局，走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Tracked leader against rail, switched to challenge leader 600m out, quickened early to lead 300m out, headed by winner 100m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。六百米處轉換跑線以挑戰領放馬。直路早段加速，三百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Driven along to chase the pace, responded well on straightening to gain narrow lead nearing 200M before battling on determinedly to prevail from pursuing rivals late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 受催策，追趕領放馬。入直路時對催策反應良佳。接近二百米處時領先短距離。末段以頑強鬥志力拼，力拒緊追的對手取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced at tail, 8 to 9 lengths back in the middle stages, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居包尾位置。中段落後八至九個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Raced in rear, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, ran on strongly to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列。未能望空直至二百米處。末段以勁勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, settle 3Ls off leaders, couldn't quicken to challenge leaders final 300M. Never likely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，落後領先馬匹三個馬位。最後三百米未能加速挑戰領先馬匹。從未看似有力爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Stayed within striking distance from leaders, briefly held up 250M but lacked a strong response in the final stages.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;保持落後領先馬匹不遠。二百五十米處一度受困，但末段對催策反應欠強勁。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, hung out and made contact near 900M, moved a bit closer along the rail on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。接近九百米處時外閃及發生觸踫。直路彎沿欄略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Well there, restrained to 3rd passing the 900M, did not find much room behind runners over 150M out, fought on well late to grab 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居好位，跑過九百米處時受約束，居第三位。一百五十米處在馬匹之後空位不足。末段以佳勢力拼，最後數步取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked leader against stand rail, pushed into lead over 150m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬，走外欄。一百五十米處受推策上前領放，走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 5 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時被碰撞，失去平衡，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, across from widest draw to lead, headed top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘時被碰撞，切入內疊領放。直路初被超越。最後二百米墮退。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped awkwardly, ridden along to lead, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘笨拙，在催策下領放。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, travelled smoothly, asserted from over 200m out under largely hand riding, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭，走勢暢順。自二百米處起大多受推策，控制大局。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along early to lead, weakened in the Straight. (Barrier Manners and Performance Unacceptable)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段在催策下領先。直路上轉弱。（閘廂行為及表現均難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 400m out, joined by rival 200m out, quickened again and won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。四百米處加速。二百米處被對手追及，再度加速，帶離對手勝出。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by I Am Invincible from Diademe, a daughter of Savabeel. Horses by the same sire include Invincible Shield and Pi Legend. This fellow had four starts for one win (a 3yo maiden over 1200m) and one placing. He was given two trials for two wins in Hong Kong. He raced handily and won by 1-3/4Ls under slight pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on September 7. In the latest trial, he sat not far off the pace and won by a neck under pressure, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 18. He looks an interesting debutant here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「至高無極」(I Am Invincible)之後，在港同父馬包括「笑傲江湖」及「偵探傳奇」等駒，生母出自「小法寶」(Savabeel)。來港前在澳洲四戰得一勝一位，頭馬為一場1200米三歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後兩次試閘全勝。9月7日出試從化草地1000米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下以1.75個馬位之先勝出。最近9月18日出試從化草地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下以一馬頸位之先勝出。初出應可交出良好表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前，獲得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover early stages, improved to track leaders two wide with cover 600m out, effort 400m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 早段跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處推進以跟隨領先馬匹，走第二疊，有遮擋。四百米處發力，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Caught wide no cover chasing leaders, had no extra final 200M and weakened out of contention. (Jockey - obliged to make use early stages to hold a forward position.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 追趕領先馬匹，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米再無餘力，轉弱，再無爭逐機會。（騎師表示，他須於早段催策坐騎以佔取前列位置。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, sent forward to race prominently, 3 wide, there to turn, kept on very well in straight, always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持甚佳走勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Wide early, improved to track leaders out wide without cover 800m out, effort 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 早段走外疊。推進以跟隨領先馬匹，八百米處走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處發力。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide after passing 600M, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。跑過六百米處後走第二疊，入直路時落後一至兩個馬位。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 7 lengths or so back, there to turn, made very good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，落後約七個馬位，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W3W) Settled down in second half of the field, closed off final 400M fastest to finish equal 3rd. Nearest line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 居後半馬群中。最後四百米衝刺最快，取得平頭季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, saved ground, closed off nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。走內欄節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W5W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W5W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5-1/2L back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground, soon recovered towards rear in 9th on rail, commenced move leaving the 700M reaching within 3L of pace on rail into straight, ran on between runners to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，其後瞬即恢復走勢，居後列第九位，走內欄。跑離七百米處時開始上前。入直路時落後領放馬不逾三個馬位，走內欄。末段在馬匹之間上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Sat midfield, traveled smoothly, showed some dash over the concluding stages, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。末段略為加速，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, had to wait for run top of home straight, clear run 250m out, strong run to lead 150m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初須等待空位出現。二百五十米處望空。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Ridden from a middle barrier to vie for lead early, gaining 1L 2nd 4-wide onto first bend, soon came to tackle leader in home straight and hit the front 300M out only to be outsprinted 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自中檔出閘後受催策，早段爭奪領先。開始轉首個彎位時進佔第二位，落後一個馬位，走第四疊。直路上瞬即上前挑戰領放馬。三百米處取得領先，僅於一百五十米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with them, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1-1/4L behind the leader on rail, easy run to turn, showed good response in straight, took the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner close home.
(Sustained a small wound to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small wound to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一又四分一個馬位，走內欄。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。
（右後腿有一個細小傷口。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, blundered near 850M, angled out 450M, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近八百五十米處時失蹄。四百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Led early, headed 1000m out, remained prominent, under pressure to chase leaders 500m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 早段領放。一千米處被超越，仍居前列。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, raced in touch with leaders, effort top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑及發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路初發力，在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, ridden along from stalls to track pace without cover, effort 500m out, no extra final 200m.
(Jockey dropped whip at 200M.)
(Sustained a minor abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a minor abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，其後受催策跟隨領先馬匹，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後二百米再無餘力。
（於二百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭失以及失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）
（左前腿輕微擦傷。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於二百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭失以及失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Showed good speed to lead, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。直路初加速，瞬即控制大局。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, weakened passing 150M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。跑過一百五十米處時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Travelled smoothly behind leading pair, challenged over 200m out, led 125m out and comfortably on top at line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居領放兩駒之後，走勢暢順。二百米處展開挑戰，一百二十五米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed 300m out, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路初受催策。三百米處被超越，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon in front setting the pace, pressured in the lead by rivals from 700M, run ended mid-straight and gave way.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即領放，主宰步速。自七百米處起在領放下受對手追迫。直路中段無以為繼，墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced prominently on the outside, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped cleanly, vied for lead first half of the race, couldn't quicken passing 400M, faded away final 200M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘俐落。賽事前半段爭奪領先。跑過四百米處時未能加速。最後二百米力竭。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From draw 1 took up early running before relinquishing the lead near 800M, retook the lead 150M but lay in forcing jockey to stop riding momentarily. Edged out to 4th near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，於早段領先。接近八百米處時失去領先優勢。一百五十米處再次取得領先，但內閃，導致騎師一度須停止催策。接近終點時被超越，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, took the lead, led by a length on turn, kept on very well in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。直路彎領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, tended to hang left under pressure final 250m, headed 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 一直領先。最後二百五十米在催策下傾向外閃。最後五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced behind midfield, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置。轉入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began well, taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, 5 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Ridden along from stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, steadied for cover halfway out, bumped 350m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。半程時收慢以取得遮擋。三百五十米處發生碰撞。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, under pressure 500m out to chase leaders, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W) Average to begin, positioned 5 lengths behind the leader, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W) 出閘一般，落後領放馬五個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Soon dropped to midfield despite niggled at early, commenced move 400M out swinging one of the widest into straight, kept on until finding no extra inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 儘管於早段受催策，但瞬即墮居中間位置。四百米處開始上前。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。保持走勢，直至一百米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W) Taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Shifted out and heavily bumped leaving stalls, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑，發生大力碰撞。留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置，末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Average to begin, raced behind midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, made some progress after passing 300M, not enough room inside final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初未能望空。跑過三百米處後略為追前。最後一百米空位不足。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield, 2 wide, a bit closer in the middle stages, angled out 550M, 3 lengths or so back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。中段略為追近。五百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Bumped start, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 500M, 4 lengths back turning in, no daylight early in straight, cleared 150M, finished off very strongly to score. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能望空。一百五十米處望空。衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Slotted into a 3-wide spot in midfield, travelled satisfactorily in the early stages but did not finish the race off on straightening. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。早段走勢令人滿意。入直路時未能以勁勢衝刺。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Sat towards the rear, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居後列。走勢平穩。
